intro.headline: Comprehensive Privacy Policy & Mobile Applications Data Governance
intro.summary: This Privacy Policy governs the collection, processing, local persistence, external transmission, and lifecycle management of data across the FuzailVerse digital portfolio platform and all associated mobile applications engineered, deployed, or maintained by Mohammad Fuzail.

generalSections.title: Introduction and Scope
generalSections.summary: Scope of governance across web and mobile deployments
paragraphs: Welcome to FuzailVerse (accessible at https://fuzailverse.pages.dev/). This Privacy Policy explains with technical fidelity how Mohammad Fuzail ("we", "us", "our", or "Operator"), acting as lead software systems architect, collects, utilizes, safeguards, and disposes of information when you interact with our web platform or utilize any mobile software applications engineered under the FuzailVerse portfolio.

We believe in radical architectural transparency. Because our software systems range from consumer gamification to enterprise channel loyalty, automotive aftermarket catalogs, healthcare practice tools, and GPS field operations, data collection is strictly tailored to the minimal technical needs of each individual application. No single application implements a blanket tracking policy.

By accessing the website, installing any FuzailVerse application from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store, or transmitting communications to us, you acknowledge the practices described in this document.
bulletPoints: Web Platform: https://fuzailverse.pages.dev/ and associated Cloudflare Pages micro-routes.
Production Mobile Applications: Enterprise, B2B, and consumer mobile software packages engineered for iOS and Android.
Direct Communications: Technical inquiries, project consultations, and security disclosures sent to mohdfuzail.dev@gmail.com.

generalSections.title: Information We Collect and Technical Categories
generalSections.summary: Voluntary submissions, device metrics, and operational data
paragraphs: We categorize information based on whether it is voluntarily provided by the user, automatically recorded as device runtime telemetry, or generated during in-app operational workflows.

subsections.subtitle: A. Information You Voluntarily Provide
content: Depending on which application or service you access, you may voluntarily submit personal data to initiate user accounts, execute business workflows, or contact engineering support:
bulletPoints: Contact and Identity Information: Full name, professional title, trade affiliation (e.g. contractor, mason, technician, doctor, distributor), telephone number, and email address.

KYC & Verification Credentials: PAN (Permanent Account Number), Aadhaar verification details, trade licenses, or business registration cards strictly where mandated by enterprise channel loyalty programs.
Transactional & Disbursement Coordinates: Bank account numbers, IFSC codes, or Unified Payments Interface (UPI) virtual payment addresses submitted solely to fulfill earned loyalty redemptions.
Operational & Business Submissions: Distributor sales invoices, product serial barcodes, physical shelf inventory photographs, prescription records, and client consultation inquiries.

subsections.subtitle: B. Technical and Device Telemetry
content: When applications interact with network infrastructure, our software and integrated SDKs automatically register essential technical runtime parameters necessary to ensure compatibility, prevent abuse, and diagnose execution faults:
bulletPoints: Hardware Specifications: Device manufacturer, hardware model, display screen density, CPU architecture, available RAM, and internal storage headroom.
Software Runtime: Operating system version (Android API level or iOS release), build signature, and application package version.
Network Diagnostics: IP address, mobile network operator, connection type (Wi-Fi, 4G, 5G), network latency, and carrier country code.
Stability Telemetry: Crash traces, thread dumps, memory allocation ceilings, and unhandled exception logs recorded at the precise instant of a software failure.

generalSections.title: Device Permissions and Hardware Access Rationale
generalSections.summary: Strict principle of least privilege for hardware access
paragraphs: Mobile operating systems enforce runtime sandbox boundaries. FuzailVerse applications request device capabilities strictly when mandatory for user-initiated actions, adhering to the principle of least privilege.

subsections.subtitle: Camera Access (android.permission.CAMERA / NSCameraUsageDescription)
content: Requested only to allow users to scan product QR codes/barcodes in real time, capture photographs of physical paper invoices for trade verification, or scan KYC identification documents.
Live camera feeds are processed exclusively within the device frame buffer; raw video streams are never recorded, silently monitored, or transmitted to background servers.

subsections.subtitle: Location Services (ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION / ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION)
content: Employed exclusively in field execution software (specifically FieldPulse by TASC) to verify that store audit check-ins occur within verified retail coordinate boundaries.

Background location tracking is activated strictly during authorized duty shifts and incorporates mock-location detection to guarantee operational integrity. Consumer loyalty apps do NOT request continuous GPS tracking.

subsections.subtitle: Storage and Media Files (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES / WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE)
content: Utilized to export generated PDF prescriptions, cache automotive parts digital catalogs for offline browsing, and select invoice images from the device gallery for submission.

subsections.subtitle: Push Notifications (POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
content: Utilized via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) to transmit transactional alerts, including reward point redemptions, milestone achievements, and urgent system notices. Users may revoke notification authorization at any time in device system settings.

subsections.subtitle: Audio and Microphone Access
content: FuzailVerse applications do NOT request or utilize microphone access. No background audio recording occurs under any circumstance.

generalSections.title: Local Data Storage and Offline-First Architecture
generalSections.summary: Secure device persistence using SQLite, Hive, and Encrypted Storage
paragraphs: A hallmark of FuzailVerse engineering is high availability in network-constrained environments. Multiple applications employ offline-first architectures where data is persisted locally on the host device before cloud synchronization.
bulletPoints: Relational Databases (SQLite / SQFLite): Used in applications such as InClinic Assistant, FieldPulse, and BirlaNu to maintain local transaction queues, appointment records, and offline catalogs. SQLite databases are sandboxed within the private app sandbox and are inaccessible to other third-party apps.
High-Speed Key-Value Indexing (Hive / SharedPreferences): Employed for sub-second SKU lookups, theme preferences, and user interface state caching.

Encrypted Secure Storage: Authentication credentials, session JWT refresh tokens, and biometric session tokens are encrypted using the Android Keystore system (AES-256 GCM) and iOS Keychain Services. Plaintext secrets are never stored in unprotected files.

Offline Transaction Queues: Submissions created without connectivity are queued locally and automatically dispatched with idempotency keys once connectivity is restored, preventing duplicate balance debits or submissions.

generalSections.title: Cloud Storage, Backend APIs, and Data Transmission
generalSections.summary: End-to-end transport security with TLS 1.3 and authenticated REST gateways
paragraphs: When data must be synchronized with cloud infrastructure, all external network transmissions take place over authenticated RESTful HTTPS interfaces using Transport Layer Security (TLS 1.3 or TLS 1.2 minimum).

Payloads are authenticated using JSON Web Tokens (JWT) with short expiration periods and secure refresh mechanisms. Image uploads (such as invoice vouchers or KYC documents) are compressed on-device prior to transmission using memory-optimized downsampling algorithms to conserve user bandwidth and mitigate server load.

Cloud backends hosting client databases are maintained in enterprise cloud availability regions (primarily Google Cloud Platform and Amazon Web Services data centers in the Asia-Pacific region, including Mumbai, India), adhering to rigorous physical and logical access controls.

generalSections.title: Firebase Suite: Analytics, Crashlytics, and Phone Authentication
generalSections.summary: Telemetry and authentication implementations powered by Google Firebase
paragraphs: Where integrated, Google Firebase SDKs provide observability and secure infrastructure:

subsections.subtitle: Firebase Analytics
content: Monitors aggregated behavioral flow, screen navigation milestones, and feature adoption rates to identify UX bottlenecks. Analytics identifiers are pseudonymized and cannot be used by the Operator to independently reconstruct a real-world identity.

subsections.subtitle: Firebase Crashlytics & Performance Monitoring
content: Captures real-time crash stack traces, non-fatal exceptions, and frame-rate rendering metrics across device tiers. This diagnostic telemetry is critical to maintaining a 99.8%+ crash-free session rate across diverse budget hardware.

subsections.subtitle: Firebase Phone OTP Authentication
content: Employed in applications such as InClinic Assistant to facilitate passwordless verification. Phone numbers submitted for SMS OTP verification are processed directly by Google Firebase infrastructure under Google privacy standards and are used exclusively to confirm device possession.

generalSections.title: Advertising Practices and Monetization Disclosure
generalSections.summary: Zero third-party programmatic ad networks across enterprise applications
paragraphs: FuzailVerse maintains a strict operational standard regarding user attention and privacy:

None of our enterprise, B2B loyalty, automotive catalog, field management, or healthcare applications integrate third-party programmatic advertising networks (such as Google AdMob, Unity Ads, Meta Audience Network, or AppLovin).
Users are never subjected to behavioral ad tracking, programmatic real-time bidding (RTB) auctions, or cross-app retargeting pixels within FuzailVerse software.
Promotional feeds present in loyalty apps (such as Classmate Star Club or BirlaNu) represent direct, client-curated product reward catalogs, not third-party commercial advertisements.

generalSections.title: Payment Processing and Financial Gateways
generalSections.summary: PCI-DSS compliant transaction processing via Razorpay and banking rails
paragraphs: Where applications support digital payments, commercial orders, or monetary incentive disbursements:

Payment processing is executed through certified, RBI-licensed payment aggregators (predominantly Razorpay). FuzailVerse applications do not directly capture, record, or store raw credit card numbers, debit card CVVs, or net banking passwords on local devices or proprietary servers.

All payment checkout flows execute inside hardened SDK webviews or API tunnels tokenized directly by the payment processor under PCI-DSS Level 1 certification. Reward disbursements (Direct Bank Transfer / UPI) are processed via validated enterprise corporate disbursement gateways.

generalSections.title: Third-Party Services and Infrastructure Integrations
generalSections.summary: Trusted platform services and external technical partners
paragraphs: Our applications interface with trusted industry infrastructure providers strictly to execute core software capabilities:
bulletPoints: Google Play Services & Apple App Store: App distribution, version auto-updates, in-app reviews, and integrity attestation.
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) & Cloudflare: Secure edge CDN delivery, domain routing, and backend server infrastructure.
Google Maps & Location Services: Geocoding and map rendering for field auditing applications.
Document OCR & Verification Services: Automated document parsing for KYC validation workflows.

generalSections.title: Data Sharing, Disclosures, and Governance
generalSections.summary: Strict non-sale clause and legitimate disclosure criteria
paragraphs: WE DO NOT SELL, RENT, MONETIZE, OR TRADE PERSONAL DATA TO THIRD-PARTY DATA BROKERS OR MARKETING FIRMS. EVER.
Information is shared strictly under the following limited operational conditions:
bulletPoints: With Enterprise Project Clients: Applications developed for specific enterprise clients (e.g. ITC, Tech Almonds, Spark Minda, BirlaNu, Parker, PepsiCo) transmit operational business data to the respective client organization that commissions and owns the digital ecosystem.
With Authorized Technical Infrastructure Vendors: Cloud hosting, database management, SMS delivery, and crash analytics providers under strict data processing agreements.
Legal and Regulatory Obligations: Where required by a valid court order, subpoena, law enforcement inquiry, or statutory regulation under applicable jurisdiction.
Protection of Vital Rights: When necessary to investigate fraudulent transactions, prevent GPS mock-spoofing, mitigate cyber-attacks, or protect the safety and property of users.

generalSections.title: Data Retention and Storage Limits
generalSections.summary: Definite retention schedules based on technical and statutory necessity
paragraphs: We adhere to data minimization principles. Information is retained only as long as necessary to fulfill the operational purpose for which it was gathered:
bulletPoints: User Account & Profile Data: Retained for the duration of the active business or commercial relationship between the user and the sponsoring enterprise platform.
Financial & Reward Records: Retained for up to 7 (seven) years to comply with statutory taxation, anti-money laundering (AML), and commercial audit regulations.
Crash & Diagnostic Telemetry: Retained in Firebase Crashlytics for 90 days before automated system purging.
Local SQLite & Cache Records: Persisted locally on the user device until the user logs out, uninstalls the software, or clears application data in operating system settings.
Portfolio Website Inquiries: Contact inquiries sent to mohdfuzail.dev@gmail.com are retained for up to 24 months to maintain engineering dialogue and consultation records.

generalSections.title: Data Deletion, Account Erasure, and User Control
generalSections.summary: Complete procedures for account closure and data purging
paragraphs: Users maintain sovereign control over their personal data. You may request account closure, personal data export, or irrevocable data deletion at any time:
bulletPoints: Email Request: Submit a deletion request directly to our designated data governance inbox: mohdfuzail.dev@gmail.com with the subject line "Data Deletion Request - [Application Name]". We process verified requests within 30 days.
In-App Account Closure: In applications supporting self-service account termination, users can initiate deletion via Account Settings > Delete Account.

Local Data Removal: Users can immediately purge all locally stored database files, cached catalogs, and cached tokens by navigating to Device Settings > Apps > [Application Name] > Clear Storage / Clear Cache, or by uninstalling the application.

generalSections.title: Technical and Organizational Security Safeguards
generalSections.summary: Cryptographic defenses, tamper protection, and defense-in-depth
paragraphs: FuzailVerse incorporates defense-in-depth architectural principles to protect information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction:
bulletPoints: Cryptographic In-Transit Security: Mandatory TLS 1.3 / TLS 1.2 with HSTS for all network communication.
At-Rest Cryptography: Mobile device secrets encrypted via hardware-backed Android Keystore and iOS Keychain.
Memory Protection: Proactive buffer management to eliminate memory leaks and ensure sensitive byte buffers are zeroed out after use.
Anti-Tampering Measures: Integrity verification, signature validation, and mock-location detection in sensitive field and transaction flows.
Code Reviews & Static Analysis: Regular dependency auditing to identify and patch vulnerable libraries prior to production store deployment.

generalSections.title: International Data Transfers and Cross-Border Processing
generalSections.summary: Safeguards for global cloud infrastructure and data sovereignty
paragraphs: While FuzailVerse is operated from New Delhi, India, cloud services utilized (such as Google Cloud, Firebase, and Cloudflare) operate globally distributed networks. Your information may be routed or processed on infrastructure located outside your home state or country.

Where cross-border transfers occur, they are governed by recognized standard contractual clauses, robust cryptographic transit safeguards, and enterprise data processing agreements ensuring equivalent data protection standards regardless of geographic routing.

generalSections.title: Children's Privacy and Protection of Minors
generalSections.summary: Compliance with COPPA, GDPR Article 8, and India's DPDP Act
paragraphs: The majority of FuzailVerse software products are enterprise, B2B, or professional healthcare tools intended exclusively for adult commercial users. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13 (or under 18 in jurisdictions where local statutory law defines minority for digital consent, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act of India).

Specific Notice for Youth & Student Loyalty Software (e.g. Classmate Star Club): Where an application caters to students and youth, data collection is deliberately constrained to non-sensitive game mechanics (notebook barcode scanning, digital badges, streaks). We do not collect precise GPS coordinates, biometric identifiers, or behavioral tracking profiles from youth users. Where required by applicable law, parental or guardian consent must be provided prior to reward redemptions.

If you believe a child has provided personal information without requisite consent, notify us immediately at mohdfuzail.dev@gmail.com and we will expeditiously expunge such records from our databases.

generalSections.title: User Privacy Rights (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and DPDP Act 2023)
generalSections.summary: Comprehensive legal rights enforceable by users worldwide
paragraphs: Depending on your jurisdiction, you possess statutory rights regarding your personal information under regulations including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA), and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP Act, India):
bulletPoints: Right to Access & Confirmation: You have the right to receive confirmation whether your data is being processed and obtain a portable copy of personal records.
Right to Rectification: You have the right to correct inaccurate, outdated, or incomplete data maintained in our systems.
Right to Erasure ("Right to Be Forgotten"): You have the right to request permanent deletion of your personal records, subject to statutory retention mandates.
Right to Restrict or Object to Processing: You have the right to restrict processing or object to automated decision-making and profiling.
Right to Data Portability: You have the right to receive your data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.
Right to Withdraw Consent: Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw consent at any time without affecting lawful prior processing.
Non-Discrimination: We will never deny services, degrade app features, or charge discriminatory rates for exercising your privacy rights.

generalSections.title: Modifications and Amendments to This Policy
generalSections.summary: Version tracking and update notification mechanisms
paragraphs: We may periodically update this Privacy Policy to reflect architectural enhancements, newly published applications, evolving regulatory frameworks, or changes in third-party SDK dependencies.

When modifications occur, the "Last Updated" timestamp at the top of this document will be updated, and version change notes will be documented in our release logs. For material changes that significantly affect user rights, we will provide prominent in-app notices or direct announcements where feasible.
Continued usage of our web platform or mobile applications following the publication of revisions constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

generalSections.title: Direct Privacy Governance and Contact Information
generalSections.summary: Direct contact channels for queries, audits, and data requests

paragraphs: Applications featuring points ledgers and reward redemptions (including BirlaNu Rewards, Parker Loyalty, Classmate Star Club, and PepsiCo Growth Club) operate under defined operational parameters:

1. No Inherent Monetary Value: Loyalty points accrued within applications represent promotional engagement units and possess no independent cash or property value outside authorized redemption workflows.

2. Fraud Auditing & Revocation: The Operator and sponsoring enterprise clients maintain the absolute right to audit all transactions. Submissions involving duplicate QR scans, counterfeit invoices, altered purchase receipts, or collusive transactions will result in the immediate forfeiture of accumulated points and permanent account termination.

3. Redemption Fulfillment: Cash disbursements (via UPI or Direct Bank Transfer) or gift card redemptions are subject to successful KYC verification and bank processing windows. The Operator is not liable for disbursement delays caused by third-party banking rails, invalid IFSC details, or recipient account restrictions.

sections.title: Prohibited Activities and Security Safeguards
sections.summary: Explicit prohibition of reverse engineering, spoofing, and tampering
paragraphs: When interacting with our web platform or applications, you expressly agree NOT to:
bulletPoints: Reverse Engineer: Decompile, disassemble, reverse engineer, or attempt to derive source code from executable application binaries or byte code.

GPS Spoofing & Mock Locations: Utilize mock-location mock providers, fake GPS software, or proxy coordinates to spoof attendance, store visits, or audit locations in field applications such as FieldPulse.
Automated Scraping: Deploy bots, scrapers, crawlers, or automated scripts to harvest catalog SKUs, pricing, contact details, or user records.
Fraudulent Submissions: Upload forged invoices, manipulated documents, misleading photos, or stolen identification credentials.
Infrastructure Tampering: Interfere with, overburden, compromise, or bypass any security control, rate limit, or firewall defending our servers.
Malicious Payloads: Inject viruses, Trojan horses, worms, logic bombs, or other technologically harmful components into our applications or backend APIs.
